tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "Do you have much free time?" Where a tile says "much / many", you choose.
B hears the question and builds the answer. Can you count it? Then many or a few. Can't you count it? Then much or a little. A tile "not" means don't / doesn't / didn't / isn't.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.
